item.title: ‘Miroirs No. 3’ Trailer: Christian Petzold’s Buzzy German Drama Heads To Theaters On March 20
item.description: We can now share a trailer for the upcoming film “Miroirs No. 3,” heading to limited theaters in March after the feature was making the rounds at film festivals last year, including the Toronto International Film Festival, Cannes Directors Fortnight, and the New York Film Festival. Written and directed by Christian Petzold (“Phoenix,” “Transit”), the German-language drama (that already has some strong critical praise) stars Paula Beer, Barbara Auer, Matthias Brandt, and Enno Trebs. item.title: Sterlin Harjo’s ‘The Lowdown’ Starring Ethan Hawke Renewed For Season 2 At FX & Hulu
item.description: Lee Raybon’s Tulsa beat isn’t over. FX has renewed the shaggy detective neo noir “The Lowdown” for a second season, with production set to begin in Tulsa this spring. Created by Sterlin Harjo (“Reservation Dogs”), the series stars Ethan Hawke as Raybon, a self-described “truthstorian” whose obsession with uncovering corruption keeps pulling him into trouble — and away from being the father he aspires to be. item.title: ‘The Strangers: Chapter 3’ Trailer: Renny Harlin Closes The Door On The Trilogy’s Masked Nightmare
item.description: The “The Strangers” brand always sold terror as something stupidly simple: a knock, a mask, a decision made for you. No motive you could bargain with, no monster you could outsmart—just an intrusion that turned ordinary space into a trap. And if this current run was built as a three-part pressure cooker, it was always going to end with someone trying to reclaim the night. item.title: ‘Sinners,’ ‘One Battle After Another’ & ‘The Studio’ Lead 2026 SAG’s Actor Awards Nominations
item.description: The SAG Awards are now the Actor Awards, but don’t let the name change confuse you. This year, the 32nd edition of the honors was announced by “Abbott Elementary’s” Janelle James and “Heated Rivalry’s” Connor Storrie. “One Battle After Another” and “Sinners” lead the film nominees with 6 and 5 nominations, respectively.
